summary: Prototype with explicit policies for every known collection and default deny for unknown/nested paths. Admin/Staff/disabled, private histories, fixed-UID Cash owner with matching email, including unverified internal accounts, owner-only Plan fields, append-only logs and contract/vendor compatibility paths tested on Emulator. User review and separate production authorization remain required.

findings.issue: External/older writers are not certified for optimized reads.
findings.mitigation: Released builds force complete-history reads; index marker remains false. Synchronous index writers and optimized query implementation are retained and tested.

findings.issue: Cash/archive nested row schemas remain flexible to preserve inherited business payloads.
findings.mitigation: Only the authorized financial owner or Admin can write these collections; resulting document type/list/map/month constraints apply to both create and update. No public access.

findings.issue: The prior RC required email_verified=true and would block the current internal owner.
findings.mitigation: Bind the known UID and matching email; approved active profile remains mandatory. Nine new regression cases plus the existing matrix, actual Auth login and full UI flows passed. No production Rules change.
